forge.instruction: Generate structurally distinct candidates. Treat Project Story Contract and Route Interface obligations as hard architecture. For ROUTE_ENGINE work, causally connect to the shared anchor and chapter roles. Do not self-censor a generative mechanism merely because it is new or adds mechanism count; favor mechanisms with high narrative leverage and avoid growing PATCH chains. Do not review or defend candidates. Return concise spines, assumptions, and largest risks.

cold_reader.instruction: Judge only what a player can infer from the frozen candidate. Flag jargon or rule density only when it impairs comprehension; do not penalize an understandable novel concept for novelty itself. Do not reconstruct author intent or repair the work.

drama_reviewer.instruction: Audit desire, opposition, action/counteraction, irreversible change, and motive continuity. Test whether mechanisms generate consequential character choices rather than turning scenes into system demonstrations. For ROUTE_ENGINE work, test whether the character engine collides with the shared story anchor. Cite decisive evidence. Do not repair.

mystery_reviewer.instruction: Audit Working Truth, evidence, Reveal Delta, fairness, and truth-versus-exposure discipline. A decisive mechanism property may be named late, but should have an earlier observable trace when required by the Story Contract. For ROUTE_ENGINE work, verify Ch4 explains and Ch5 reinterprets the shared anchor rather than a substitute mystery. Do not repair.

logic_scout.instruction: Audit causal, knowledge, physical, information, and hard task-contract consistency. Distinguish high-leverage ENGINE/SUPPORT rules from PATCH chains whose main job is repairing prior rules. Return CLEAR, RISK, or DEAD with decisive blockers only. Story Contract violations are not rescued by internal coherence. Do not repair.

synthesizer.instruction: Converge from frozen candidates and reviews. Enforce Story Contract and Route Interface obligations before ranking quality. Prefer higher narrative leverage and shallower PATCH dependency at comparable story quality; do not mechanically prefer fewer mechanisms or punish a strong novel ENGINE. Use SELECT, FUSE, FORK, DROP, or ROLLBACK_PARENT. Do not invent facts solely to neutralize objections.
